items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: It was the singer that afterwards became Paramount Richards. And I was in the staff.

ctx.x: Weekly, the news is going on. It's the news. I'm thinking of a guy in a theater. That music, Tassel never did. When I was a leader of the Liberty Theater, I had to feature my own pictures. I had to sit there with my first violinist and he'd have a tap. And I'd say, the theme this week, I'd pick out a nice theme for two lovers to clinch. We used to have a first and second theme, secondary theme. And I'd always close the curtain with my theme. And I'd talk it over with the manager who was a palomar. I'd say, how…
I know you must have played in a lot of different kind of places to do that. No.
